metadata.description: In Rajasthan, an upcoming election scheduled for the end of this year holds significant importance for both the ruling Congress and BJP parties. the tribal votes are pivotal in determining the government in the state. Among the 200 constituencies in the state, 25 are reserved for Scheduled Tribes. Notably, 17 of these reserved seats are located in South Rajasthan, which is predominantly Bhil-dominated. On September 10th, a new political party named "Bharat Adivasi Party" will be officially announced by tribal leaders in the state. This development has sparked discussions and anticipation regarding its potential impact on the upcoming election dynamics. we bring you a detailed discussion with the leaders who are launching this party.
